column1: # conc.tsv — the concurrency dial's measured rows Tab-separated.
# variant_key
# variant_key: the VARIANT name for shipped manifests; sha256:<16 hex> for a custom manifest path (the file's
#              own hash — a path means nothing on another box). ./glm53 conc prints this table for the VARIANT.
# attic: on|off. on = measured with the memory-reserve layer (spark-attic) lending (ATTIC=1; needs a gr8 image
#              with the attic client); off = the stock memory layout (the pinned image). ATTIC selects which rows a boot uses.
# tokens_per_session: the largest T (1,024-token grid) with CONC x pages_a_rank(T) <= pages, by the engine page
#              rule at SHARE_LIMIT 16384 (a session incl. its 320-token generation needs
# Rows are boots that held the serving floor (MemAvailable ready >= 9 GiB, never under 8 GiB under load, per box).
# A CAP above a row's value for the same CONC+attic is your call (the recipe warns; it does not refuse).
# No fitted or interpolated CAP ships here. Rows still measuring say "measuring" in the CAP cell.
